name: rebu-expense-agent
title: REBU 报销助手
description: Drive the KONE/通力 expense-reimbursement system through the REBU MCP server. Orchestrates auth → setup → collect → confirm → assemble → check → export → recycle with human-in-the-loop discipline.
author: REBU Team

routing.disambiguation_prompt: 连接 REBU 完整处理，还是离线分析本地资料？
service_conditions: User needs: mailbox sync, persistent records, controlled templates, or formal Excel export
portable_conditions: User only processing local extracted text/structured data

REBU_API_BASE.description: REBU API server base URL (e.g. https://rebu.example.com or http://127.0.0.1:3001)

REBU_MCP_TOKEN.description: Pre-minted Bearer JWT for static auth (provide via Secret Store or env, never in chat)

REBU_USERNAME.description: Auto-login username (provide via Secret Store or env, never in chat)

REBU_PASSWORD.description: Auto-login password (provide via Secret Store or env, never in chat)

REBU_MCP_STATE.description: Path to local credential cache file (default: ~/.rebu-mcp/state.json)

review_actions.label: 调整信息或金额
review_actions.description: Correct fields then confirm; must supply field patch

review_actions.label: 申请豁免并说明原因
review_actions.description: Acknowledge policy breach with justification; reason required

review_actions.label: 补充信息
review_actions.description: Supply missing fields (date, route, attendees, etc.)

review_actions.label: 稍后处理
review_actions.description: Skip this item; no action taken, persists for next session

output_contract.$comment: Shared OutputManifest contract per §6.8.2 item 3 — both service and portable skills produce equivalent structured outputs

CanonicalInvoiceFields.description: Canonical invoice fields with source/confidence per field; shared field set between service and portable skills

PolicyFindings.description: Policy check results: over-limit, over-time, missing docs, etc.

ReviewQuestions.description: Items requiring explicit user confirmation before proceeding

ReimbursementDraft.description: Structured reimbursement draft with line items, totals, and budget summary

OutputManifest.description: Provenance and versioning metadata for the output bundle

policyPackVersion.description: Version of the policy rule pack used

templatePackVersion.description: Version of the Excel template pack (if applicable)

fileHashes.description: SHA-256 hashes of generated output files

confirm_gates.description: Invoices with low-confidence extraction, missing fields, or suspected duplicates require explicit user confirmation before proceeding.
confirm_gates.trigger: invoice status == need_confirm OR confidence < threshold
confirm_gates.action: Present details and recommendations; wait for user decision using normalized actions (keep/adjust/provide_info/defer)

confirm_gates.description: Policy checks (over-limit, over-time, missing supporting docs) must be shown to the user. User decides to keep (cap to standard), exempt with reason, or adjust.
confirm_gates.trigger: policy_checks with level=warn found for reimbursement
confirm_gates.action: List policy findings with impact; require keep/exempt(+reason)/adjust

confirm_gates.description: Invoice deletion (soft-delete to recycle bin). Reversible but must be disclosed before execution.
confirm_gates.action: Confirm with user which invoice(s) to delete; state: soft-delete, recoverable via rebu_restore_invoice

confirm_gates.description: Any outbound email action requires explicit user approval.
confirm_gates.action: Show recipient, subject, content summary; wait for explicit go-ahead

external.name: REBU API Server
external.description: The REBU backend providing auth, invoice processing, policy engine, template generation, and mailbox sync

companion_skills.name: kone-expense-reimbursement
